description: List the workspace's sender addresses, ordered by address, 50 to a page. Send `domainId` to list only one mail domain's. Each one has its `id` (the `mailboxId` that send_transactional_message takes), `address`, `domainId`, `displayName`, `replyTo` (where replies go), `createdAt` and `createdBy`. A deleted sender address is not listed.

cursor.description: Where the last page stopped: the nextCursor of the answer before. Use it with the same filters it came with. Left out, the list starts at the beginning.

domainId.description: Only sender addresses on this mail domain.

limit.description: How many to return in one page, 1 to 200. Left out, the server picks.

name: list_sender_addresses
title: List the sender addresses
